newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Magpek to restructure, inject capital.
newsitem.headline: Magpek to restructure, inject capital.

text.p: Magpek Exports Ltd said on Monday the company would cease manufacturing from January 17 to restructure and inject working capital.

"The company was badly affected by a labour strike in the first half of 1996, which led to the loss of orders, and rise in overhead costs," Magpek chief executive officer A.I. Mylvaganam told Reuters.
He said he saw little use in running the group's factory at 20 percent capacity at a high cost to shareholders until the company restructured.
The Colombo Stock Exchange earlier said it had suspended trading in the company's shares until January 16.
Magpek manufactures children's toys and wooden educational material for export. The shares last traded at 3.25 rupees on January 10. --Colombo newsroom (941) 434319
